text_block_list.text: ...It's certainly not that easy, is it?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Please don't apologize. If anything,
I am the one who should be sorry for asking the impossible of you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I always end up relying on you too much, don't I, Trainer?
choice_data_list: I'll do my best to win it next time...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, if there's a next time, let's do it again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
